title: cli-telemetry-spec event
description: The COMPLETE set of fields a conforming CLI may send. additionalProperties is false on purpose: this schema is the allow-list from PROTOCOL.md §3.1, and a validator rejecting an unknown field is the enforcement mechanism. Anything identifying is absent by construction, not by policy.

verb.description: a subcommand name from the tool's own fixed list. The pattern forbids spaces, so an argument cannot be smuggled in.

exit_class.description: the semantic exit-code class from cli-output-spec, never a message

install_id.description: OPTIONAL. Random at first run, never derived from the machine. Omitting it is the safer default.
